name: @yiioffice/shell
description: Unified YiiOffice shell: one app hosting the docs and sheets modules behind a home/launcher window

scripts.dist:mac: npm run notices && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run notices && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:win:installer: npm run notices && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run notices && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux --publish never

author: YiiOffice
